item.title: Nigeria shuts schools as 300+ kids abducted
Israel strikes Hamas targets: Airstrikes launched on Gaza amid fragile ceasefire; over 20 killed
item.description: Israel launched airstrikes in Gaza, killing five senior Hamas members and 24 Palestinians, including children, following reported gunfire at Israeli troops. These strikes occurred shortly after the UN Security Council approved a US-backed plan for Gaza's security and governance, which includes an international stabilization force.

item.title: ‘Doing this to children is evil’: Former UK PM Liz Truss blasts NHS for giving puberty blockers to children as young as 10
item.description: Former UK Prime Minister Liz Truss has strongly condemned a new NHS clinical trial offering puberty blockers to children as young as 10, labelling it 'evil' and a revival of 'dangerous transgender ideology'. Truss argues the trial amounts to 'state-sanctioned harm', failing to learn from past safeguarding failures at the Tavistock clinic.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: End of an era? CBS Saturday Morning reportedly shutting down after network ousts its longtime hosts
item.description: CBS Saturday Morning, a 28-year television staple, is reportedly ending as CBS News faces significant shake-ups and layoffs. Long-time hosts Michelle Miller and Dana Jacobson were dismissed, with no permanent replacements yet named. This move reflects broader cost-cutting measures at parent company Paramount Skydance, impacting numerous roles across the organization.
item.dc:creator: TOI Entertainment Desk

item.title: Indian-origin Congressman flags possible 'tampering' in Epstein files, writes to FBI's Kash Patel: 'Trump using...'
item.description: In a bold move, Congressman Suhas Subramanyam is calling on the FBI to protect the files related to Jeffrey Epstein and to probe into possible political meddling. Highlighting troubling anecdotal evidence, he voiced concerns over President Trump's impact on the release of these sensitive documents.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Ban phones in Jewish schools’: Obama’s former speechwriter says, alleges ‘Gaza images make defending Israel impossible’
item.description: Former Obama speechwriter Sarah Hurwitz advocates for banning smartphones in Jewish schools until senior year. She argues that constant exposure to graphic Gaza images traumatizes children and hinders efforts to explain Israel's position. Hurwitz believes this measure would protect students' mental health and allow educators to discuss the conflict without overwhelming, algorithm-driven content.

item.title: Indian student who stabbed two teenagers with fork mid-flight indicted in Boston; faces up to 10 years, $250,000 fine
item.description: In a shocking turn of events aboard a Lufthansa flight, Indian national Praneeth Kumar Usiripalli was hit with federal charges in Boston. Allegedly wielding a metal fork as a weapon, he reportedly assaulted two teenagers mid-flight, prompting an emergency diversion to the U.S.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: JFK's 35-year-old granddaughter Tatiana Schlossberg reveals she has less than a year to live after terminal cancer diagnosis
item.description: John F. Kennedy's granddaughter, Tatiana Schlossberg, revealed her terminal cancer diagnosis in a personal essay. The 35-year-old journalist has acute myeloid leukemia and was told she has less than a year to live. She detailed her treatment journey and the immense support from her family.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Why is streaming community calling for HasanAbi’s Twitch ban? Streamer sparks outrage after snapping on loyal subscriber
item.description: Popular streamer Hasan “HasanAbi” Piker is facing severe backlash after telling a loyal viewer to "die" during a live broadcast. The incident, which occurred on November 15, 2025, saw Piker react angrily to a comment about his appearance. Fellow streamers and viewers are calling out the behavior, citing potential Twitch Terms of Service violations and past bans for similar remarks.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Candace Owens drops explosive claim on Charlie Kirk's assassination with shocking twist about Tyler Robinson fingerprints
item.description: Candace Owens questions the official narrative surrounding Charlie Kirk's shooting, suggesting a planned setup involving multiple individuals. She claims Tyler Robinson's role was limited, with his fingerprints not being the only ones on the weapon. Owens also alleges Lance Twiggs played a more significant, albeit different, part in the incident, citing a TMZ video as evidence.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Saudi Arabia to permit foreign property ownership from 2026: Here’s what you can buy
item.description: Saudi Arabia is opening its real estate market to foreigners from January 2026, allowing property ownership and investment. This move, part of Vision 2030, aims to attract global wealth, boost market quality, and create jobs.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Good boy’ Mamdani and Trump ‘in control’: Body language expert decodes White House meeting
item.description: In a remarkable twist, the long-anticipated rendezvous between Mayor-elect Zohran Mamdani and President Trump unfolded in an atmosphere filled with unexpected warmth, as noted by body language expert Carole Lieberman. She characterized Mamdani’s demeanor as delightfully enthusiastic, reminiscent of a 'curious puppy', while Trump exercised a subtle dominance over the conversation.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Candace Owens calls Charlie Kirk story crazy and questions the role of Tyler Robinson and his lover Lance Twiggs
item.description: Candace Owens has raised doubts about the official account of Charlie Kirk's death. She questions the timeline and the suspect, Tyler Robinson alleged actions. Candace Owens points to inconsistencies in the evidence presented. She suggests the accepted story has significant flaws involving the suspect's lover. Her podcast explores these discrepancies for her audience.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Massive Milestone: Dubai Police cuts response time to 5.8 minutes, achieves 5,200 rescues in 10 months
item.description: Dubai Police Search & Rescue teams completed over 5,200 missions in the first 10 months of 2025, significantly reducing land-incident response times to an average of 5.8 minutes. This achievement, driven by smart technology and upgraded readiness, surpasses strategic targets and highlights the force's commitment to rapid emergency response.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 2,500 New Yorkers showed up for an old man’s five-minute cigarette break invitation
item.description: A five-minute cigarette invitation from a Brooklyn pensioner known as “Breaking Bob” unexpectedly became New York’s latest viral flash-mob. After clips of him handing out flyers in Washington Square Park spread online, roughly 2,500 people showed up for his “cigarette with me” meet-up. Bob used the moment to warn the crowd against smoking before leading a surreal, citywide smoke break.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Is JD Vance jealous of Zohran Mamdani? Fox News anchor says Trump prefers the socialist as his 'running mate'
item.description: In a surprising twist, President Trump's inviting Oval Office conversation with Democrat socialist Zohran Mamdani has seemingly left Senator JD Vance feeling overshadowed, as reported by Fox News. Despite their differing ideologies, Trump complimented Mamdani's 'rational' approach and identified areas of agreement, contrasting sharply with his previous critiques.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Coup case: Ex- Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro taken to prison from house arrest; 27-year jail term begins
item.description: Former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro has been arrested. He was taken into custody on Saturday. This comes days before he was due to start a 27-year prison sentence. The sentence is for leading an attempted coup in 2022. Federal police acted on a Supreme Court directive. Bolsonaro was moved from his residence to police headquarters.
